notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): MSUI's micro menu (Program.ActionBars.cs DrawMicroMenu) matches the reference row: eight 29x58 buttons at the bar's x=552 recess with real UI-MicroButton-* Up/Down art, the character button's live portrait overlay, the 18px top hit-rect inset, shared additive highlight, pushed-state tracking against each panel's open flag, and all eight clicks wired (Character, Spellbook, Talents, Quest Log, Social, World Map, Game Menu incl. the modal click-through law, Help). Benilla still has Help as a no-op, so MSUI is ahead there.
